warnings: Third pile-cap enlargement sheet, same layout as S-07 and S-08.
BOTTOM STEEL STEPS UP TO Ø16 ON BOTH CAPS (12-Ø16), while the top stays at Ø12 (15-Ø12 on F10, 14-Ø12 on F12). Every earlier cap used Ø12 both faces, so this is the first size change in the series.

F10 HAS A STAGGERED PILE PATTERN, not a grid. Its x chain is eight equal 0.35 steps because the two outer rows (three piles each, at 0.70 / 1.40 / 2.10) sit half a step off the middle row (four piles, at 0.35 / 1.05 / 1.75 / 2.45). F12 by contrast is a plain 4 x 3 grid at 0.70 m. Reading F10's chain as a 0.70 module would place its piles wrongly.

Both caps are 0.35 m thick, continuing the pattern that thickness grows with pile count (F3 0.20, F6 0.25, F8 0.30, F10/F12 0.35). All other depth figures are unchanged: 1.00 to the cap top, 0.05 pile-head embedment, 0.30 pier, 0.10 lean projection, 0.08 lean concrete over 0.08 sand. Computed pile-head level is -1.30 on both.
F16 -- the largest mark on the S-02 plan -- is still not detailed. It must be on S-10 (PNG 43), which the S-01 index calls 'ขยายฐานรากเสาเข็ม F18'. That naming conflict is resolved on the next sheet.
